name: The Worst
abilities: Near-total physical invulnerability - soft, malleable body absorbs heavy blows ('Atrocians are indestructible')
Withstands energy attacks such as Exo-Skull's laser
Limited resistance to Chronosapien/Chronian time rays thanks to dead skin and calluses
weaknesses: Feels every bit of pain despite being indestructible
No offensive options - effectively a punching bag
Needs oxygen: cannot breathe underwater or survive in space
Poison-resistant, not immune; can be killed by anything that disintegrates organic matter (e.g. the Non-Baryonic Disruptor Chamber)
summary: A fat yellow blob in green underwear that cannot be destroyed, cannot hurt anyone, and feels every hit - Ben's least favourite alien and one he never chose on purpose.
traits: Omnitrix symbol on his outie belly button
Every single appearance was an unintentional transformation
Shares his home planet with Ball Weevil (Derrick J. Wyatt)
Design based on the way storyboard artist Jae Hong Kim draws aliens
Sharpened Taydenite could possibly break his skin
notableFeats: Defeated Mallice by absorbing her beating until she collapsed from exhaustion (No Honor Among Bros)
Survived Exo-Skull's laser and being tossed into Exo-Skull's horn, which flung him and Maltruant's crew into Mad Ben's timeline (It's a Mad, Mad, Mad Ben World: Part 1)
Tried to hold off Liam, Fistina, Bubble Helmet and Psyphon with the Plumbers (Outbreak)

notableEpisodes: It's a Mad, Mad, Mad Ben World: Part 1
appearances.designNotes: Round yellow blob with wart-like bumps on forehead and arms, elephant-like three-toed feet, bear-like hands with blunt claws, green underwear with white stripes; Omnitrix symbol on the belly button.

image.label: OV
image.notes: Infobox render (transparent) but only 250x257 - a cutout of the promo image 'N50b95ce2907ab_large-1-.png' (400x380, teal background).

scoring.rationale: Durability 8: shrugs off Mallice's beating, Exo-Skull's laser and lava. That is the whole package - he cannot attack, barely moves, still feels pain, needs air, and Ben only ever became him by accident, hence heavy weakness and control penalties.

notes: Home planet 'Atrocius 0' is marked '(formerly)' on the wiki - the Atrocians no longer live there.
One of four aliens accidentally unlocked by Blukic and Driba in Outbreak; voiced by Yuri Lowenthal there, then Dee Bradley Baker.
Albedo cannot transform into The Worst. Considered for the Reboot but unused.
